name: – Lara Wolters – After § 11 – Am 10
title: REPORT on competition policy – annual report 2024
part_text: 11a. Stresses that State aid should not amount to a transfer of public wealth to the private sector; calls on the Commission and the Member States to ensure that strict social and environmental conditions are imposed on companies receiving State aid, including prohibitions on closures, production cutbacks, relocations and the distribution of dividends to shareholders and bonuses to upper management, and the obligation to create high-quality, highly paid, unionised jobs with extensive labour participation rights and credible plans for the ecological transformation;
